title: Bounded connection pool for build results
name: Build results pool

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code limits, hands out and recycles database connections? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Eight threads hold connections and a ninth calls pool.connection(). The pool's max_size is 8. What happens?
choices: A ninth connection is opened because creation is not capped
The call waits up to acquire_timeout for a returned lease and then raises PoolExhausted
The call blocks until a connection is returned, with no time limit
The ninth thread shares one of the eight leased connections

questions.prompt: Inside `with pool.connection()`, a query raises sqlite3.OperationalError. What happens to that connection?
choices: It is returned to the idle queue after a rollback
It stays leased until the process exits
It is closed rather than reused, and its slot is freed for another caller
It is closed, but its slot stays consumed so the pool shrinks permanently

questions.prompt: A pool with max_age=1800 receives a burst of traffic, then goes quiet for two hours with several idle connections. When are those idle connections closed?
choices: Exactly at 1800 seconds, by a background reaper thread
As soon as the burst ends, because release() closes extra connections
Never, because max_age applies only to leased connections
Lazily: each is closed when a later checkout pops it and finds it older than max_age
